_readme: Single source for FLOW-TRACKER.md (table) and ISSUES-BY-FLOW.md (per-flow sections). Edit here, then run: python tools/docs.py

flows.name: Success Submit Email
flows.problems: Email failure is silent; backup uses a retired API (dead)
flows.stage: **Sandbox tested.** T1 reproduced; T2–T6 pass; emails and Teams alerts confirmed by the user. One alert-text defect (raw JSON on blank email) fixed and re-run
flows.next: User glances at the 2 newest Teams alerts → **office-ready**
flows.title: Success Submit Email (student confirmation email)
issues: If the email fails to send (bad or blank address, expired connection) the flow stops and nobody is told
✅ Try/Catch + Teams alert + mark run Failed
The only backup uses SharePoint's SendEmail API, **retired 31 Oct 2025**, so it does nothing; and it only runs on time-out, not on failure
Backup path hard-codes Kamal's address as sender; breaks on names with an apostrophe
Power Automate's own failure-alert subscription is off for the flow
Subject uses the UTC month ("…for September Semester")
Only export without the `[LIVE-CDO]` tag; unclear if it's switched on in production
Connections expire and then fail with `Unauthorized`
Alert for a blank email showed raw connector JSON
✅ fixed and re-run; message text awaits your Teams look

flows.name: Acknowledgement Letter Email Process
flows.problems: Deprecated file trigger (3 outputs the new one doesn't provide); strict Excel format; approvals gate
flows.stage: **Trigger swap + subfolder guard sandbox-tested on a harness** (T-H1/H2/H3/H5, and T-H4b 2026-10-02: a direct file fires once, a subfolder file does not). The rest of the flow (approvals, scripts, letters) is untested until a real office run. Harness Off
flows.next: Confirm with CDO that staff never use subfolders; office test last (needs its own mini-plan)
flows.title: Acknowledgement Letter Email Process (appointment letters)
issues: Uses the **deprecated** "When a file is created in a folder" trigger (likely cause of flaky letter drop)
The old trigger supplies content, name and path; the replacement supplies none of these, so a bare swap breaks the flow
🔶 handled: Get file content added, 3 expressions remapped
The replacement trigger also fires for files in subfolders (the old one didn't)
The dropped Excel must match an exact format (`Course`/`Host Company` headers with a trailing space, table named `Database`); otherwise the scripts fail
⬜ candidate cause of "Excel reading doesn't work"
Failures inside the cleaning scripts give only a generic FAILED message
Cleaned copies were named with `%20` for spaces (old trigger's encoded name)
Read; **Observed** the new name is plain
Excel template and Office Script referenced by hard-coded IDs; replacing the template file breaks the flow silently
The rest of the flow (2 Teams approvals, Word→PDF, emails) has never been run outside production
⬜ only an office run can test it

flows.title: Store Student List into SharePoint List (sandbox-tested 2026-09-30; real-Excel ok 2026-10-06)
issues: Uses the **deprecated** file trigger (same as flow 2)

**Loop risk:** the flow archives the processed file into `StudentList_DropFile/Archive Student List`, a *subfolder of the watched folder*. With the replacement trigger this could re-trigger on its own archived file, so the subfolder guard is mandatory
✅ guard sandbox-tested: the archive move did not re-trigger
**No failure alert at all**; a failure just stops (run history at least shows Failed)
The "Excel moved to Archive" message posts even if the move failed for a reason other than a file lock
Excel read uses the trigger's path header; the replacement's `Identifier` can't be tested without a live Excel connection
⬜ verify at the office with a real test file
Reads the whole existing list before de-duplicating by email (pagination is set to 100,000)
**Concurrent runs create duplicate students** (3 files dropped together → 5 rows for 2 students)
⬜ CDO decision (concurrency limit or write-time check)
Baseline reports failed runs as "Succeeded" (as flow 3)
On failure the file stays in the drop folder and the trigger won't re-fire for it; staff must re-drop
